title.narrative: Modernization of Audit Methodologies and Practices of the State Audit of Vietnam

description.narrative: The DO of the grant is to progress SAV's audit standards, methodologies, and procedures, toward alignment with International Organization of Supreme Audit Institutions (INTOSAI) standards and international good practices. Component 1 Development of legal framework: (i) Assessment of current regulations and procedures of SAV and INTOSAI including a gap analysis; and (ii) development of SAV's guiding documents on auditing standards and methodologies - USD 215,000 Sub-components: 1.1 Translate audit standards and materials,,25,000 1.2 International consultants,,99,000 1.3 National consultants ,,66,000 1.5 Peer Review,,25,000 ,, Component 2 Dissemination of developed and issued policies - USD 195,000 Sub-components: 2.1 Study tour,,40,000 2.2 Evaluation workshops,,20,000 2.3 Training courses,,135,000 Component 3 Project audit - USD 10,000 Total ,, USD 420,000 The development objective of the grant is to strengthen the institutional capacity of the State Audit of Vietnam (SAV) through delivery and implementation of modern risk-based audit methodologies for finance and compliance audits. The project objective is fully aligned with the SAV strategic vision to 2020 and incorporates INTOSAI 's 2007 guidance on 'Building Capacity of SAIs'.
